words.enDefinition: an official document showing that someone is permitted to drive specified vehicles

examples.en: I took my driving licence to the counter when collecting the rental car.
examples.zh: 我去柜台取租来的车时，带上了「驾驶执照」。

examples.en: The clerk checked the photograph on my driving licence against my booking details.
examples.zh: 柜台人员核对了「驾驶执照」上的照片和我的预约信息。

words.enDefinition: a permit allowing someone to practise driving subject to local restrictions

examples.en: The driving school asked whether I already had a learner permit for lessons.
examples.zh: 驾校问我是否已有上课所需的「学员驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I showed my learner permit to the instructor before my first driving lesson.
examples.zh: 上第一节驾驶课前，我向教练出示了「学员驾驶许可证」。

words.enDefinition: a standard driving licence issued after the learner or restricted stage

examples.en: The rental form asked whether I held a full driving licence or a permit.
examples.zh: 租车表格问，我持有的是「正式驾驶执照」还是学习许可。

examples.en: I had to show my full driving licence when collecting the replacement car.
examples.zh: 去取替换车辆时，我得出示「正式驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: a test assessing a person's ability to control a vehicle and drive safely in practice

examples.en: I booked my practical driving test for the morning after lectures ended.
examples.zh: 我把「实际驾驶考试」约在课程结束后的一天上午。

examples.en: The driving school helped me find the address for my practical driving test.
examples.zh: 驾校帮我找到了「实际驾驶考试」的地址。

words.enDefinition: an examination of the knowledge needed for driving, such as road signs and rules

examples.en: I revised the road signs before taking the theory test on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五参加「驾驶理论考试」之前，我复习了道路标志。

examples.en: The driving school sent me a reminder about the theory test next week.
examples.zh: 驾校发消息提醒我，下周要参加「驾驶理论考试」。

words.enDefinition: a test of how well a driver notices developing hazards in road situations

examples.en: The UK practice session included a hazard perception test with recorded traffic scenes.
examples.zh: 英国的练习课有一项「驾驶危险识别测试」，用的是预录的道路场景。

examples.en: I asked how the hazard perception test differed from the multiple-choice section.
examples.zh: 我问「驾驶危险识别测试」和选择题部分有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a person who teaches people how to drive a vehicle

examples.en: The driving instructor met me outside the student residence before our first lesson.
examples.zh: 「驾驶教练」在第一节课前到学生公寓外与我见面。

examples.en: I asked my driving instructor about changing the afternoon lesson to Friday.
examples.zh: 我问「驾驶教练」能不能把下午的课改到周五。

words.enDefinition: a period of guided practice with someone teaching you to drive

examples.en: I moved my driving lesson because it overlapped with a laboratory session.
examples.zh: 我的实验课时间撞了，所以把「驾驶课」改了期。

examples.en: The driving lesson began in a quiet car park near the sports centre.
examples.zh: 「驾驶课」从体育中心附近一个安静的停车场开始。

words.zhGloss: 仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照
words.enDefinition: a licence whose vehicle permissions restrict the holder to automatic transmission in a specified category
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照

examples.en: The rental form asked me whether my automatic-only licence covered the selected car.
examples.zh: 租车表格问，我的「仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照」是否适用于选中的车。

examples.en: The instructor pointed to the code for an automatic-only licence on the sample.
examples.zh: 教练指出，样本上哪个代码代表「仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照」。

collocations: a restriction on an automatic-only licence

words.enDefinition: a standardized document translating driving licence details for use alongside the original abroad

examples.en: The hire desk asked whether I had an international driving permit with me.
examples.zh: 租车柜台问我有没有随身带「国际驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I checked that my international driving permit listed the same details as my licence.
examples.zh: 我核对了「国际驾驶许可证」上的信息是否和驾照一致。

collocations: apply for an international driving permit

words.enDefinition: a driving licence issued in a country other than the one currently being discussed

examples.en: The rental desk asked which country had issued my overseas driving licence.
examples.zh: 租车柜台问我的「境外签发的驾驶执照」是哪个国家发的。

examples.en: I brought my overseas driving licence to the appointment at the transport office.
examples.zh: 我带着「境外签发的驾驶执照」去交通办事处赴约。

collocations: drive on an overseas driving licence

words.enDefinition: a code used by UK licensing services to share specified driving licence information

examples.en: The British rental company asked for a licence check code before handing over the keys.
examples.zh: 英国租车公司在交钥匙之前要求提供「驾照记录查询码」。

examples.en: I asked where to generate a licence check code on the government website.
examples.zh: 我问在政府网站哪里能生成「驾照记录查询码」。

words.enDefinition: a class on a driving licence showing a type of vehicle the holder may drive

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the licence category printed beside the small vehicle symbol.
examples.zh: 办事员指着小车辆图标旁印的「准驾车型类别」。

examples.en: I asked which licence category the rental form was referring to on that line.
examples.zh: 我问租车表格那一行说的是哪个「准驾车型类别」。

words.enDefinition: the process of extending or reissuing a driving licence as its validity ends

examples.en: I received a confirmation message about my licence renewal in the online account.
examples.zh: 我的在线账号收到了一条「驾驶执照续期」确认消息。

examples.en: The counter had a separate sign for licence renewal and first-time applications.
examples.zh: 柜台用不同的牌子区分「驾驶执照续期」和首次申请。

words.enDefinition: the process of replacing a licence issued elsewhere with one issued locally

examples.en: The transport office explained which records it needed for a licence exchange.
examples.zh: 交通办事处说明了「换领当地驾驶执照」需要哪些材料。

examples.en: I booked a licence exchange appointment after I moved into the new flat.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓后，我预约了「换领当地驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: an official record of a person's driving licence status and certain driving history

examples.en: The company asked for permission to view my driving record before the rental.
examples.zh: 租车前，公司征求我同意查看「驾驶记录」。

examples.en: I read my driving record before discussing the incorrect date with staff.
examples.zh: 和工作人员讨论错误日期之前，我先看了自己的「驾驶记录」。

collocations: a copy of your driving record

words.enDefinition: points recorded for certain driving offences in jurisdictions using a points system

examples.en: The Australian notice listed demerit points on a separate line below the fine.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的通知在罚款下面单列了一行「交通违规记分」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the sample record showed the demerit points.
examples.zh: 我问样本记录哪部分显示了「交通违规记分」。

words.enDefinition: the official process or record linking a vehicle to the relevant registration authority

examples.en: The car-share app showed the vehicle registration details beside the number plate.
examples.zh: 共享汽车应用在车牌号旁显示了「车辆登记」信息。

examples.en: I checked the address on the vehicle registration record after moving to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到学校后，我核对了「车辆登记」记录上的地址。

words.enDefinition: a plate attached to a vehicle showing its official identification number or combination

examples.en: I checked the number plate to make sure I had found the correct car.
examples.zh: 我看了看「车牌」，确定自己找的是那辆车。

examples.en: The parking machine asked me to enter the number plate from my rental.
examples.zh: 停车缴费机让我输入租来那辆车的「车牌」信息。

words.enDefinition: the service or arrangement of paying to use a car temporarily

examples.en: We shared the cost of car rental for our weekend trip out of town.
examples.zh: 周末出城玩时，我们分摊了「汽车租赁」费用。

examples.en: The visitor guide listed car rental near the bus and rail information.
examples.zh: 游客指南在大巴和铁路信息附近列出了「汽车租赁」服务。

words.enDefinition: a car that someone pays to use for an agreed period

examples.en: The rental car was in a numbered space beside the pick-up office.
examples.zh: 「租来的汽车」停在取车办公室旁一个有编号的车位里。

examples.en: We returned the rental car before taking the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 坐公交回学校之前，我们还了「租来的汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a business that rents cars to customers for temporary use

examples.en: I contacted the car rental agency after seeing two dates on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我发现确认单上有两个日期，就联系了「汽车租赁公司」。

examples.en: The car rental agency had an office just outside the train station.
examples.zh: 这家「汽车租赁公司」在火车站外面有个办公室。

collocations: book with a car rental agency

words.enDefinition: the desk where a customer completes a car rental or returns the keys

examples.en: I waited at the rental counter while my classmate found the booking email.
examples.zh: 同学找预约邮件时，我在「租车服务柜台」等着。

examples.en: The rental counter was on the ground floor beside the station exit.
examples.zh: 「租车服务柜台」在底层，就在车站出口旁。

collocations: check in at the rental counter

words.enDefinition: a rental branch located outside an airport's main premises

examples.en: The booking confirmation gave directions to the off-airport rental location near our hotel.
examples.zh: 预约确认单说明了怎么去酒店附近的「机场外租车点」。

examples.en: We took a local bus to the off-airport rental location on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六我们坐当地公交去「机场外租车点」。

collocations: pickup at an off-airport rental location

words.enDefinition: the interval during which the customer is allowed to keep the rented vehicle

examples.en: I checked that the rental period covered both days of our weekend trip.
examples.zh: 我确认了「租车期限」涵盖周末旅行的两天。

examples.en: The agreement listed the end of the rental period alongside the return location.
examples.zh: 协议把「租车期限」的结束时间和还车地点列在一起。

collocations: the end of the rental period

words.enDefinition: the time or process of collecting a vehicle for use

examples.en: I confirmed the vehicle pickup before booking a train to the rental location.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「取车」安排，再订去租车点的火车票。

examples.en: The agent moved the vehicle pickup to a different branch near the station.
examples.zh: 代理把「取车」安排改到了车站附近另一家门店。

words.enDefinition: the time or process of leaving a rented vehicle at an agreed location

examples.en: The map showed where vehicle drop-off was located inside the multi-storey car park.
examples.zh: 地图标出了多层停车楼里「还车」的地方。

examples.en: I checked the vehicle drop-off address before leaving for the station that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上去车站前，我先确认了「还车」地址。

words.enDefinition: a rental that lets the customer collect a car in one place and return it elsewhere

examples.en: We chose a one-way rental because our train home left from another city.
examples.zh: 我们回家坐的火车从另一座城市发车，所以选择了「异地还车租赁」。

examples.en: The website showed which branches could accept the car from a one-way rental.
examples.zh: 网站显示，哪些门店能接收「异地还车租赁」的车辆。

words.enDefinition: returning a rented vehicle when the rental location is closed or unstaffed

examples.en: The booking included instructions for an after-hours return on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 预约里附有周日晚上「非营业时间还车」的说明。

examples.en: I asked the agent where to leave the vehicle for an after-hours return.
examples.zh: 我问代理，「非营业时间还车」时该把车停在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a contract stating the terms for using a rented vehicle

examples.en: I saved a copy of the rental agreement in my travel folder.
examples.zh: 我在旅行文件夹里留了一份「租车协议」副本。

examples.en: The rental agreement listed the rate and the time to return the car.
examples.zh: 「租车协议」列明了费用标准和还车时间。

collocations: the terms of a rental agreement

words.enDefinition: an approved arrangement to keep a rented vehicle beyond the original ending time

examples.en: I requested a rental extension when our evening train was cancelled suddenly.
examples.zh: 晚上的火车突然取消，我申请「延长租车期限」。

examples.en: The agent emailed a rental extension with a revised time to return the car.
examples.zh: 代理发来「延长租车期限」的邮件，里面写了新的还车时间。

collocations: the cost of a rental extension

words.enDefinition: the charge per day for using a particular rental vehicle

examples.en: We compared the daily rental rate for two classes of car online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上比较了两类汽车的「每日租车费率」。

examples.en: The quote listed a daily rental rate before taxes and other fees.
examples.zh: 报价先列了「每日租车费率」，再列税款和其他费用。

words.enDefinition: a category used by rental companies to group vehicles with similar size or features

examples.en: I asked whether the rental class guaranteed a particular model or only a category.
examples.zh: 我问「租车车型等级」能否保证拿到某一型号，还是只代表车型类别。

examples.en: The website changed the rental class after the smaller vehicles became unavailable.
examples.zh: 小车型无车可租后，网站改了「租车车型等级」。

collocations: cars in the same rental class

words.enDefinition: a small car designed to be economical to operate, often an entry rental class

examples.en: We booked an economy car because only two people were travelling that weekend.
examples.zh: 周末只有两个人出行，我们订了一辆「经济型汽车」。

examples.en: The company replaced our economy car with a larger vehicle at pickup.
examples.zh: 取车时，公司给我们换了辆更大的车，替代原订的「经济型汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a car in a relatively small size class, with definitions varying between companies

examples.en: I checked that the compact car had enough room for our two bags.
examples.zh: 我确认了「紧凑型汽车」能放下我们的两个包。

examples.en: The rental counter offered a compact car after we asked about parking space.
examples.zh: 我们问了停车空间的问题后，租车柜台给我们提供了一辆「紧凑型汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle transmission that changes gears automatically without manual gear selection in ordinary driving

examples.en: I checked whether the rental car was equipped with automatic transmission before confirming.
examples.zh: 确认预订前，我核实了车上是否装有「自动变速器」。

examples.en: The listing showed automatic transmission in the same column as the seating capacity.
examples.zh: 车型列表把「自动变速器」和载客人数列在同一栏。

words.enDefinition: a transmission in which the driver selects gears and usually operates a clutch

examples.en: The agent asked whether we had booked a car with manual transmission.
examples.zh: 代理问我们订的是不是装有「手动变速器」的车。

examples.en: I compared the price of manual transmission cars with the automatic options.
examples.zh: 我比较了装「手动变速器」的车和自动挡车型的价格。

collocations: drive a vehicle with manual transmission

words.enDefinition: a lever, dial or set of controls for selecting a vehicle's gear or drive setting

examples.en: The agent pointed out the gear selector before handing me the vehicle keys.
examples.zh: 把车钥匙交给我之前，代理指给我看「挡位选择器」在哪里。

examples.en: The gear selector was a small dial rather than a traditional lever.
examples.zh: 车上的「挡位选择器」是个小旋钮，不是传统的杆。

words.enDefinition: the person listed as primarily responsible for driving or renting the vehicle

examples.en: The rental clerk checked the main driver before adding my classmate to the agreement.
examples.zh: 租车柜台人员先核对了「主驾驶人」，再把同学加进协议。

examples.en: I updated the main driver field after our travel plans changed for Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六行程变了之后，我更新了「主驾驶人」一栏。

words.enDefinition: a person listed to drive the rented vehicle in addition to the main driver

examples.en: We asked whether an additional driver could be added at the rental counter.
examples.zh: 我们问能不能在租车柜台增加一名「附加驾驶人」。

examples.en: The agreement listed the fee for an additional driver below the rental rate.
examples.zh: 协议在租车费率下方列出了「附加驾驶人」的费用。

words.enDefinition: a person who has permission under the rental terms to drive the vehicle

examples.en: I checked whether I was listed as an authorized driver on the agreement.
examples.zh: 我查了自己是否在协议上被列为「获准驾驶的人」。

examples.en: The rental agency asked whether the person returning the car was an authorized driver.
examples.zh: 租车公司询问，还车的人是不是「获准驾驶的人」。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge some rental companies apply to a driver below a specified age

examples.en: The quote displayed a young driver surcharge on a separate line at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，报价单另列了一项「年轻驾驶人附加费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the young driver surcharge shown applied to the whole booking.
examples.zh: 我问显示的「年轻驾驶人附加费」是否适用于整笔预订。

collocations: the amount of a young driver surcharge

words.enDefinition: the status of meeting an organization's or jurisdiction's requirements to drive a vehicle

examples.en: The rental website explained driver eligibility in a section beside the booking form.
examples.zh: 租车网站在预约表旁专门介绍了「驾驶人资格」。

examples.en: I asked which document was needed to confirm driver eligibility for this booking.
examples.zh: 我问这笔预约要提交什么材料确认「驾驶人资格」。

words.enDefinition: whether particular types of vehicles are available for use at a requested place or time

examples.en: I checked vehicle availability before choosing which branch to collect the car from.
examples.zh: 我先查了「车辆供应情况」，再决定去哪家门店取车。

examples.en: The website updated vehicle availability after I changed the pickup date to Saturday.
examples.zh: 我把取车日期改到周六后，网站更新了「车辆供应情况」。

collocations: vehicle availability on a selected date

words.enDefinition: to reserve a vehicle to rent at an agreed time and location

examples.en: I wanted to book a rental car before the weekend trip was finalized.
examples.zh: 周末行程定下来之前，我想先「预订租车」。

examples.en: The visitor desk showed us where we could book a rental car nearby.
examples.zh: 访客服务台告诉我们，附近可以去哪儿「预订租车」。

collocations: book a rental car in advance
book a rental car for the weekend

words.enDefinition: to go to a specified place and receive the keys for a vehicle

examples.en: I went to collect the keys after signing the rental agreement at reception.
examples.zh: 在接待处签完租车协议后，我去「领取车钥匙」。

examples.en: The confirmation said to collect the keys from the desk beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 确认单上说，要到入口旁的柜台「领取车钥匙」。

collocations: collect the keys at the desk
be ready to collect the keys

words.enDefinition: a check of a vehicle's exterior by walking around it and looking for damage

examples.en: The agent carried out a walk-around inspection before we left the rental lot.
examples.zh: 我们开出租车场之前，代理做了一次「绕车检查」。

examples.en: I joined the walk-around inspection to see which scratches were already recorded.
examples.zh: 我参加了「绕车检查」，看看哪些划痕已被记录。

words.enDefinition: a document describing a vehicle's condition, often including existing marks or damage

examples.en: I compared the vehicle condition report with the photos taken at pickup.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆状况记录」和取车时拍的照片做了对照。

examples.en: The vehicle condition report showed a small mark near the passenger door.
examples.zh: 「车辆状况记录」显示，乘客侧车门附近有个小印痕。

words.enDefinition: a small area where a piece of the vehicle's paint has come off

examples.en: I showed the clerk the paint chip beside the rear passenger door.
examples.zh: 我给柜台人员看了后排乘客车门旁一处「小块车漆剥落」。

examples.en: The paint chip was marked on the condition report as an existing defect.
examples.zh: 这处「小块车漆剥落」在车况记录上标成了原有瑕疵。

words.enDefinition: a superficial scrape or mark on a wheel, often on the rim

examples.en: The vehicle report included a wheel scuff near the front of the car.
examples.zh: 车辆记录写了车前部有一处「车轮擦痕」。

examples.en: I pointed out the wheel scuff before the agent handed over the keys.
examples.zh: 代理交钥匙之前，我指出了那处「车轮擦痕」。

words.enDefinition: a small damaged spot in the front window of a vehicle

examples.en: The agent marked a windshield chip near the corner of the glass.
examples.zh: 代理在记录中标了一处靠近玻璃角的「挡风玻璃小缺口」。

examples.en: I noticed the windshield chip while looking at the condition report photos.
examples.zh: 我看车辆状况记录的照片时，注意到了「挡风玻璃小缺口」。

words.enDefinition: damage to the protective front or rear part of a vehicle

examples.en: The agent took photos of the bumper damage during our rental inspection.
examples.zh: 检查租车时，代理拍下了「保险杠受损」的照片。

examples.en: The report noted bumper damage on the lower rear corner of the vehicle.
examples.zh: 记录注明车尾下角有「保险杠受损」。

words.enDefinition: the total distance shown on a vehicle's distance counter at a particular time

examples.en: The desk recorded the odometer reading before handing the keys to us.
examples.zh: 柜台把钥匙交给我们前，记录了「里程表读数」。

examples.en: I checked the odometer reading against the number printed on the vehicle report.
examples.zh: 我把「里程表读数」和车辆记录上印的数字做了核对。

words.enDefinition: the distance a customer may drive under a rental rate before extra charges apply

examples.en: I checked the mileage allowance before deciding which town to visit on Sunday.
examples.zh: 决定周日去哪座城之前，我先查了「租车包含的里程数」。

examples.en: The agreement listed the mileage allowance above the charge for going beyond it.
examples.zh: 协议在超出里程的收费上方列出了「租车包含的里程数」。

words.enDefinition: a rental arrangement with no specified cap on the distance included in the rate

examples.en: The quote showed unlimited mileage next to the daily price for that car.
examples.zh: 那辆车的每日报价旁标了「不限行驶里程」。

examples.en: I asked whether unlimited mileage applied to the whole rental period after changing dates.
examples.zh: 改了日期后，我问整个租期是否都「不限行驶里程」。

words.enDefinition: a fee for distance driven beyond the amount included in a rental agreement

examples.en: The invoice listed an excess mileage charge below the daily rental rate.
examples.zh: 账单在每日租车费率下面列了一项「超出里程的收费」。

examples.en: I asked how the excess mileage charge had been calculated for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问那趟行程「超出里程的收费」是怎么算出来的。

collocations: an excess mileage charge per mile

words.enDefinition: an instrument showing how much fuel remains in a vehicle's tank

examples.en: I checked the fuel gauge before we left the rental lot that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午离开租车场前，我看了「燃油表」。

examples.en: The fuel gauge showed just under half when we returned the vehicle.
examples.zh: 我们还车时，「燃油表」显示略少于半箱。

words.enDefinition: the amount of fuel in a vehicle's tank at a given time

examples.en: The agent recorded the fuel level alongside the car's mileage at pickup.
examples.zh: 取车时，代理记录了「油箱剩余油量」和车辆里程。

examples.en: I took a photo of the fuel level before returning the keys.
examples.zh: 交还车钥匙前，我拍下了「油箱剩余油量」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a fuel policy in which a car is collected full and returned full

examples.en: The agent explained the full-to-full policy when I asked about the fuel charge.
examples.zh: 我问燃油收费时，代理说明了「满油取还政策」。

examples.en: The agreement marked full-to-full policy beside the description of the fuel level.
examples.zh: 协议在油量说明旁标了「满油取还政策」。

collocations: a rental with a full-to-full policy

words.enDefinition: a rental rule about fuel at pickup and return and how fuel charges are handled

examples.en: I read the fuel policy before choosing between two similar rental offers.
examples.zh: 在两个相近的租车报价里选之前，我读了「租车燃油约定」。

examples.en: The fuel policy was printed below the mileage information in the agreement.
examples.zh: 协议把「租车燃油约定」印在里程信息下面。

words.enDefinition: an option to pay in advance for fuel supplied with a rented vehicle

examples.en: The agent offered prepaid fuel when we collected the car near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近取车时，代理提出可选「预付燃油」。

examples.en: I asked which amount on the quote was for the prepaid fuel option.
examples.zh: 我问报价上哪项是「预付燃油」选项的金额。

words.enDefinition: a fee charged when the rental company adds fuel after a vehicle is returned

examples.en: The invoice showed a refueling charge below the basic daily rental rate.
examples.zh: 账单在基本日租费率下面列了一笔「补加燃油费」。

examples.en: I asked the agent what the refueling charge covered on my final invoice.
examples.zh: 我问代理，最终账单上的「补加燃油费」包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: the kind of fuel a vehicle is designed to use, such as petrol or diesel

examples.en: I checked the fuel type on the rental agreement before stopping at the station.
examples.zh: 在加油站停车前，我核对了租车协议上的「燃油种类」。

examples.en: The sticker beside the cap gives the fuel type for that vehicle.
examples.zh: 加油口旁边的贴纸标明了这辆车的「燃油种类」。

words.enDefinition: petrol produced without intentionally added lead compounds

examples.en: The label inside the fuel flap said the car took unleaded petrol.
examples.zh: 加油口盖里的标签写着，这辆车用「无铅汽油」。

examples.en: I saw unleaded petrol listed separately from diesel on the pump display.
examples.zh: 我看到加油机显示屏把「无铅汽油」和柴油分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the removable or hinged cover sealing the opening used to fill a fuel tank

examples.en: The agent showed me where the fuel filler cap sat behind the flap.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看外盖后面的「油箱加注口盖」在哪里。

examples.en: I checked the fuel filler cap before taking the car back to the depot.
examples.zh: 把车开回租车场之前，我检查了「油箱加注口盖」。

words.enDefinition: the small outer flap on a vehicle covering access to the fuel filler

examples.en: The fuel door was on the opposite side from the one on my friend's car.
examples.zh: 这辆车的「加油口外盖」在我朋友那辆车的另一侧。

examples.en: I looked for the button that opened the fuel door on our rental.
examples.zh: 我找了找租来的车上哪个按钮能打开「加油口外盖」。

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy that covers specified risks from renting or using a vehicle

examples.en: I asked whether the rental insurance was included in the price shown online.
examples.zh: 我问网上显示的价格是否包含「租车保险」。

examples.en: The rental insurance summary listed coverage for different kinds of loss separately.
examples.zh: 「租车保险」摘要把不同损失类型的保障分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a rental-company agreement to reduce liability for specified damage to the rented vehicle

examples.en: The agent explained the collision damage waiver before I read the agreement.
examples.zh: 我读协议前，代理说明了「碰撞损坏责任减免」。

examples.en: The quote listed a collision damage waiver separately from the daily hire rate.
examples.zh: 报价把「碰撞损坏责任减免」和每日租车费率分开列出。

collocations: terms of a collision damage waiver

words.enDefinition: a rental waiver limiting responsibility for specified losses, which may include theft and damage

examples.en: The form listed the loss damage waiver beside other optional rental protections.
examples.zh: 表格把「车辆损失责任减免」与其他可选租车保障列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the loss damage waiver described theft as well as damage.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆损失责任减免」是否既包含损坏也提到了失窃。

collocations: terms of a loss damage waiver

words.enDefinition: the amount a renter can be required to pay toward covered vehicle damage

examples.en: I found the damage excess listed near the top of the UK rental quote.
examples.zh: 我在英国租车报价的上方找到了「租车损坏自付额」。

examples.en: The agent showed where the damage excess appeared on the vehicle agreement.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看，车辆协议在哪里写了「租车损坏自付额」。

collocations: the amount of the damage excess

words.enDefinition: insurance covering certain amounts you may owe to other people for harm or damage

examples.en: The US rental guide discussed liability coverage separately from damage to the rental car.
examples.zh: 美国租车指南把「第三方责任保障」和租赁车辆损坏分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked where the policy explained liability coverage for damage to someone else's vehicle.
examples.zh: 我问保单哪里说明了损坏别人的车时，「第三方责任保障」如何适用。

words.enDefinition: help provided when a vehicle breaks down or has a problem on the road

examples.en: The rental agreement gave a number for roadside assistance in a separate box.
examples.zh: 租车协议用单独的方框列了「道路救援服务」的联系电话。

examples.en: We called roadside assistance after the car would not start near our hostel.
examples.zh: 汽车在旅舍附近启动不了，于是我们联系了「道路救援服务」。

words.enDefinition: a policy or service plan covering specified assistance after a vehicle failure

examples.en: The UK quote described breakdown cover on a separate page from the rental terms.
examples.zh: 英国报价把「车辆故障救援保障」和租车条款分在不同页面。

examples.en: I asked whether the plan called breakdown cover included transport to a repair garage.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆故障救援保障」是否包含把车运到修理厂。

words.enDefinition: a record of damage found on a vehicle, often with its location and description

examples.en: The agent handed me a vehicle damage report after taking photographs of the bumper.
examples.zh: 代理拍了保险杠照片之后，递给我一份「车辆损坏报告」。

examples.en: I checked whether the vehicle damage report showed the same mark as my photograph.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆损坏报告」记录的是不是照片里那处印痕。

words.enDefinition: a fee for cleaning a vehicle or item beyond what is included in an agreement

examples.en: The final rental invoice showed a cleaning charge under the extra fees section.
examples.zh: 租车的最终账单在额外费用一节列出了一项「清洁费」。

examples.en: I asked the clerk for a description of the cleaning charge listed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我请办事员说明收据上列的「清洁费」具体是什么。

words.enDefinition: a charge for returning a rented item after the agreed time

examples.en: The agreement lists a late return fee below the scheduled drop-off time.
examples.zh: 协议在计划还车时间下面列出了「逾期还车费」。

examples.en: I called the rental company to ask about the late return fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话给租车公司，询问「逾期还车费」。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for returning a rented vehicle to a different location

examples.en: The quote listed a one-way drop-off fee because we were returning the car elsewhere.
examples.zh: 因为我们要去别处还车，报价列了一笔「异地还车附加费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the one-way drop-off fee was included in the advertised price.
examples.zh: 我确认了广告价格是否包含「异地还车附加费」。

words.enDefinition: an amount charged for moving to a higher rental vehicle class

examples.en: The rental desk offered a larger car with a small upgrade charge.
examples.zh: 租车柜台提供了一辆更大的车，但需加一点「升级车型费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the upgrade charge was already included in the new quote.
examples.zh: 我问新的报价是不是已经包含「升级车型费」。

words.enDefinition: a road for which drivers must pay a fee to use it

examples.en: The route planner showed one way that crossed a toll road near the city.
examples.zh: 线路规划工具显示，有条路要经过城市附近的「收费公路」。

examples.en: We noticed that the toll road had a separate sign at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我们注意到「收费公路」在入口有单独的标识。

collocations: avoid a toll road on the map

words.enDefinition: a road charge collected electronically instead of at a staffed payment booth

examples.en: The road sign explained that an electronic toll applied on that section.
examples.zh: 道路标识说明，这一段收「电子道路通行费」。

examples.en: I asked how the electronic toll would appear on the rental invoice.
examples.zh: 我问「电子道路通行费」会在租车账单上怎样显示。

words.enDefinition: a device in a vehicle that communicates with equipment recording electronic tolls

examples.en: The agent showed me the toll transponder attached near the rearview mirror.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看，后视镜附近装的「电子通行费感应装置」。

examples.en: I asked whether the toll transponder was already included in our rental.
examples.zh: 我问「电子通行费感应装置」是不是已经包含在租车服务里。

collocations: a toll transponder in the vehicle

words.enDefinition: a payment notice stating the charges for using a toll road

examples.en: The toll invoice listed the road name and the date of travel.
examples.zh: 「道路通行费账单」列了公路名称和出行日期。

examples.en: I compared the toll invoice with the route shown in our trip history.
examples.zh: 我把「道路通行费账单」和乘车记录显示的线路做了比较。

collocations: a copy of the toll invoice

words.enDefinition: a widened area where vehicles pass through lanes set up to collect tolls

examples.en: The highway widened as we approached the toll plaza before the bridge.
examples.zh: 快到桥前的「收费站广场」时，高速公路变宽了。

examples.en: The map marked the toll plaza with a symbol beside the main road.
examples.zh: 地图在主路旁用一个标志标出了「收费站广场」。

collocations: a toll plaza on the highway

words.zhGloss: 按车牌号计收的通行费
words.enDefinition: an electronic toll linked to the vehicle's registration plate
acceptedZhAnswers: 按车牌号计收的通行费

examples.en: The notice described a pay-by-plate toll for vehicles without a transponder.
examples.zh: 通知说明，没有感应装置的车辆走的是「按车牌号计收的通行费」的方式。

examples.en: I asked where the pay-by-plate toll was recorded on our rental invoice.
examples.zh: 我问租车账单上的哪一项是「按车牌号计收的通行费」。

collocations: an invoice for a pay-by-plate toll

words.enDefinition: a separate fee for processing a toll payment or notice, often in a rental

examples.en: The rental invoice listed a toll administration fee next to the road charge.
examples.zh: 租车账单在道路通行费旁列了笔「通行费代办手续费」。

examples.en: I asked the rental company to explain the toll administration fee on that line.
examples.zh: 我请租车公司解释那一行的「通行费代办手续费」。

words.enDefinition: parking in a lot, garage or other space away from the public roadway

examples.en: We looked for off-street parking near the hostel before checking in that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上办入住前，我们在旅舍附近找了个「非路边停车」的地方。

examples.en: The guest information listed off-street parking behind the building near the garden.
examples.zh: 住客信息标明，大楼后面花园附近可以「非路边停车」。

words.enDefinition: a marked parking space arranged for vehicles used by people with accessibility needs

examples.en: The map marked an accessible parking bay near the venue's step-free entrance.
examples.zh: 地图在场馆的无台阶入口附近标了一个「无障碍停车位」。

examples.en: I asked which accessible parking bay was nearest the door to the reception area.
examples.zh: 我问哪个「无障碍停车位」离接待区入口最近。

collocations: use a designated accessible parking bay

words.enDefinition: a parking system where drivers pay and display a ticket in the vehicle

examples.en: The small UK car park used pay-and-display instead of a barrier at the exit.
examples.zh: 这个英国小停车场实行「缴费后展示票据」，出口没有闸杆。

examples.en: I asked the attendant which sign explained the pay-and-display system beside the library.
examples.zh: 我问管理员，图书馆旁哪块牌子介绍了「缴费后展示票据」的制度。

words.enDefinition: a small display set to show when a vehicle arrived in a timed parking space

examples.en: The visitor guide showed a parking disc in its example of short-stay parking.
examples.zh: 游客指南在短时停车的例子里展示了一个「停车时间盘」。

examples.en: I asked what time to set on the parking disc shown in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南图示里的「停车时间盘」应该设置成什么时间。

collocations: a parking disc in the windshield

words.enDefinition: a document or record allowing a person or vehicle to park under stated conditions

examples.en: I applied for a parking permit after moving into the new student residence.
examples.zh: 搬进新的学生公寓后，我申请了「停车许可证」。

examples.en: The map showed which lots accepted the parking permit connected with my account.
examples.zh: 地图标出了哪些停车场认可我账号里的「停车许可证」。

words.enDefinition: an official notice imposing or recording a charge for a parking violation

examples.en: I asked which restriction the parking ticket referred to on that street.
examples.zh: 我问「停车违章罚单」指的是那条街上的哪项限制。

examples.en: The rental office sent me a copy of the parking ticket with its invoice.
examples.zh: 租车办公室把「停车违章罚单」副本连同账单发给了我。

words.enDefinition: confirmation from a business or venue that reduces or covers a customer's parking charge

examples.en: The café offered parking validation for visitors who used the nearby garage.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆给使用附近停车楼的顾客办理「停车费减免确认」。

examples.en: I asked at reception whether the student event included parking validation for guests.
examples.zh: 我在接待处问，学生活动有没有给来宾提供「停车费减免确认」。

words.enDefinition: a rule limiting where, when or under what conditions a vehicle may park

examples.en: I checked the parking restriction printed below the main sign near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我查了入口附近主标识下方印的「停车限制」。

examples.en: The map explained which parking restriction applied during the street festival that weekend.
examples.zh: 地图说明，那周末街头节庆期间会实行哪种「停车限制」。

words.enDefinition: an area where ordinary parking is prohibited

examples.en: The sign marked a no parking zone beside the vehicle entrance to campus.
examples.zh: 标识把学校车行入口旁标为「禁止停车区」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant where the no parking zone ended near the hall.
examples.zh: 我问管理员，大厅附近的「禁止停车区」到哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: a designated area for vehicles to stop while loading or unloading goods

examples.en: The driver pulled into the loading zone behind the residence with our boxes.
examples.zh: 司机载着我们的箱子开进了宿舍后面的「装卸车辆临停区」。

examples.en: The map labelled the loading zone separately from the ordinary visitor parking.
examples.zh: 地图把「装卸车辆临停区」和访客停车位分开标注。

words.enDefinition: an area where vehicles may stop briefly to let passengers get out

examples.en: We met our classmate at the drop-off zone outside the conference building.
examples.zh: 我们在会场外的「乘客下车临停区」和同学会合。

examples.en: A temporary sign moved the drop-off zone to the side street for the event.
examples.zh: 活动期间，一块临时牌子把「乘客下车临停区」改到了侧街。

words.enDefinition: parking available only to vehicles covered by the required permit

examples.en: The sign at the back of the residence said permit-only parking.
examples.zh: 学生公寓后面的牌子写着「仅限持证停车」。

examples.en: The visitor map shaded permit-only parking differently from public parking near the library.
examples.zh: 访客地图用不同底色区分了「仅限持证停车」和图书馆附近的公共停车。

words.enDefinition: a physical arm or gate controlling vehicle entry or exit at a parking site

examples.en: The parking barrier lifted when the machine recognized our ticket at the exit.
examples.zh: 出口机器识别停车票后，「停车场闸杆」抬了起来。

examples.en: We waited for the parking barrier while the attendant checked the registration number.
examples.zh: 管理员核对车牌号时，我们在「停车场闸杆」前等候。

collocations: a parking barrier at the exit

words.enDefinition: a parking system that records a vehicle's use without issuing a paper ticket

examples.en: The hotel switched to ticketless parking last term, according to its guest notice.
examples.zh: 酒店的住客通知说，上个学期开始改用「无纸票停车」。

examples.en: I asked how ticketless parking worked when I drove in from the side entrance.
examples.zh: 我问从侧门开进去时，「无纸票停车」系统怎么记录。

words.enDefinition: a published schedule of charges for parking

examples.en: The parking tariff was printed near the upper corner of the sign.
examples.zh: 「停车收费标准」印在标识上角附近。

examples.en: I compared the parking tariff for weekdays with the rates shown for Sundays.
examples.zh: 我比较了工作日的「停车收费标准」和周日列出的价格。

words.enDefinition: the longest period a vehicle may remain in a parking space under stated conditions

examples.en: The parking sign showed a maximum stay beside the hourly fee.
examples.zh: 停车牌在每小时收费旁边注明了「最长允许停留时间」。

examples.en: I asked whether the maximum stay applied to the car park all day.
examples.zh: 我问停车场是不是一整天都适用「最长允许停留时间」规定。

collocations: a maximum stay of two hours

words.enDefinition: a service providing vehicles that members or customers can book for temporary use

examples.en: Our classmate used a car-sharing service to collect supplies for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 同学用了「共享汽车服务」，去取展览需要的物资。

examples.en: I checked whether the car-sharing service had vehicles near the student residence.
examples.zh: 我查了「共享汽车服务」在学生公寓附近有没有可用车辆。

words.enDefinition: membership of a service that lets users book shared cars

examples.en: I signed up for car-share membership before my placement outside the city.
examples.zh: 去城外实习前，我注册取得了「共享汽车会员资格」。

examples.en: The app showed when my car-share membership would need to be renewed.
examples.zh: 应用显示我的「共享汽车会员资格」什么时候要续期。

words.enDefinition: a marked parking space reserved for a shared vehicle or service

examples.en: The map showed the car-share bay behind the student hall near the gate.
examples.zh: 地图标出了学生礼堂后门附近的「共享汽车专用车位」。

examples.en: I found the car-share bay by looking for the numbered sign.
examples.zh: 我找到了写着编号的牌子，也找到了「共享汽车专用车位」。

collocations: return a vehicle to a car-share bay

words.enDefinition: a pickup arrangement that lets the customer access a vehicle without collecting a physical key

examples.en: I selected keyless pickup when reserving the car for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 预订周末出游的车时，我选了「无钥匙取车」。

examples.en: The app showed that keyless pickup was available at the station location.
examples.zh: 应用显示车站这个租车点支持「无钥匙取车」。

words.enDefinition: a car-sharing model that starts and ends a booking in the same designated place

examples.en: The round-trip car share required us to bring the vehicle back to campus.
examples.zh: 「原点归还式共享汽车」要求我们把车开回学校。

examples.en: I used a round-trip car share for an errand close to our flat.
examples.zh: 我用「原点归还式共享汽车」在公寓附近办了点事。

words.enDefinition: a car-sharing model that allows pickup and return at different permitted locations

examples.en: I compared point-to-point car share with the return-to-origin option for that errand.
examples.zh: 那次要出门办事，我比较了「异地归还式共享汽车」和原处归还的选项。

examples.en: The service map showed where point-to-point car share pickups and returns were allowed.
examples.zh: 服务地图标明了在哪些地方可以取还「异地归还式共享汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a warning showing that a vehicle has relatively little fuel remaining

examples.en: The low-fuel alert appeared while we were driving back from the campus event.
examples.zh: 我们从校园活动现场开车回去时，出现了「燃油不足提示」。

examples.en: I noticed the low-fuel alert when checking the dashboard before leaving the lot.
examples.zh: 离开停车场前，我看仪表盘时注意到「燃油不足提示」。

words.enDefinition: a location where an electric vehicle can be connected to charging equipment

examples.en: The hotel map marked an EV charging point near the back entrance.
examples.zh: 酒店地图在后门附近标了一个「电动汽车充电点」。

examples.en: I asked which EV charging point was available for visitors that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上访客能用哪个「电动汽车充电点」。

words.enDefinition: one period during which an electric vehicle is connected and receives electricity

examples.en: The receipt listed the charging session separately from the parking charge that day.
examples.zh: 收据把当天的「一次车辆充电」和停车费分开列出。

examples.en: I checked when the charging session ended before leaving the car park.
examples.zh: 离开停车场前，我查了「这次车辆充电」什么时候结束。

collocations: the cost of a charging session

words.enDefinition: the amount of energy remaining in a battery, often displayed as a percentage

examples.en: I checked the charge level on the dashboard before returning the electric car.
examples.zh: 还电动汽车前，我看了仪表盘上的「电池电量水平」。

examples.en: The app showed a different charge level after the vehicle was plugged in.
examples.zh: 车接上充电后，应用显示的「电池电量水平」变了。

words.enDefinition: the socket on a device or vehicle through which charging power is supplied

examples.en: The rental agent pointed out the charging port on the side of the car.
examples.zh: 租车代理指给我看车侧面的「充电接口」。

examples.en: I checked where the charging port was before connecting at the station.
examples.zh: 在充电站接线前，我先看了「充电接口」在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: the predicted distance a vehicle can travel on its remaining fuel or charge

examples.en: The range estimate on the dashboard changed after we drove up a long hill.
examples.zh: 开过一段长坡后，仪表盘上的「预计续航里程」变了。

examples.en: I checked the range estimate before choosing which parking area to use.
examples.zh: 选择停车区之前，我先看了「预计续航里程」。

words.enDefinition: a flashing light used to indicate that a vehicle is turning or changing lanes

examples.en: The driving instructor showed me which lever controlled the turn signal on that car.
examples.zh: 教练给我看了那辆车上哪根拨杆控制「车辆转向灯」。

examples.en: I noticed that the turn signal was still flashing after we parked by campus.
examples.zh: 在学校旁停好车后，我注意到「车辆转向灯」还在闪。

words.enDefinition: movable blades that clear water or dirt from a vehicle's front window

examples.en: I turned on the windshield wipers as soon as the rain started on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速上一下雨，我就打开了「挡风玻璃雨刷」。

examples.en: The rental agent showed us how to turn on the windshield wipers.
examples.zh: 租车代理给我们演示了怎么开「挡风玻璃雨刷」。

words.enDefinition: an interior mirror that gives a driver a view through the back window

examples.en: The rental tag was attached to the rearview mirror when we collected the car.
examples.zh: 我们取车时，租车标签挂在「车内后视镜」上。

examples.en: I adjusted the rearview mirror before leaving the parking space with the instructor.
examples.zh: 和教练一起驶出车位之前，我调整了「车内后视镜」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of room available in a car's rear luggage compartment

examples.en: We checked the boot space to see whether the exhibition display would fit.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「汽车后备厢空间」，看看能不能装下展品。

examples.en: The rental listing showed boot space beside the number of passenger seats.
examples.zh: 租车车型列表把「汽车后备厢空间」和乘客座位数列在一起。

words.enDefinition: a small storage compartment in a vehicle's dashboard, usually on the passenger side

examples.en: The agent left the rental documents in the glove compartment beneath the dashboard.
examples.zh: 代理把租车文件放在仪表台下方的「前排储物盒」里。

examples.en: I found the charging card in the glove compartment before returning the car.
examples.zh: 还车前，我在「前排储物盒」里找到了充电卡。

collocations: keep papers in the glove compartment

words.enDefinition: a vehicle's flashing lights that warn others about a hazard or stopped vehicle

examples.en: The parked van had its hazard lights on beside the blocked street.
examples.zh: 封闭街道旁停着一辆厢式车，开着「危险警示闪光灯」。

examples.en: The instructor pointed to the red switch for the hazard lights in the rental.
examples.zh: 教练指出，租来的车上那个红色开关控制「危险警示闪光灯」。

collocations: drive with the hazard lights flashing

words.enDefinition: a brake used to keep a parked vehicle from moving

examples.en: The instructor showed me where the parking brake switch was on this car.
examples.zh: 教练指给我看，这辆车上的「驻车制动器」开关在哪里。

examples.en: The rental had a button for the parking brake near the gear selector.
examples.zh: 租来的车在挡位选择器附近有个「驻车制动器」按钮。
